properties.entry: SELECT G.GROUP_NUM, G.GROUP_NAME, G.GROUP_DESC, G.GROUP_TYPE, G.GROUP_OWNER_NUM, TO_CHAR(G.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GROUP_MEMBERS WHERE GROUP_NUM = G.GROUP_NUM AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'A') AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM GROUPS G JOIN GROUP_MEMBERS GM ON G.GROUP_NUM = GM.GROUP_NUM WHERE GM.USER_NUM = ? AND GM.MEMBER_STATUS = 'A' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY GM.JOIN_DATE DESC
